title: Extreme heat
summary: Find a cooler place, reduce activity, and check on people at higher risk.
steps: Follow National Weather Service heat alerts for your area. Avoid strenuous outdoor activity during the hottest hours.
Drink water regularly unless a clinician has told you to limit fluids. Find shade or air conditioning.
Check on older adults, children, and people with health conditions. Never leave people or pets in a parked car.
For severe symptoms such as confusion or loss of consciousness, call 911.
